Show romanized text for non-Latin scripts when available
Decorative sparkle trail at the sweep\'s leading edge
Thanks to meowarex for supporting VeloSonic

When enabled, Radiant Lyrics uses a server-side AI model to generate word-for-word timing for songs that only have plain line-by-line lyrics. Off by default — turning this on sends your request to that AI model.
Try the server first, then lrclib.net
Server-provided lyrics only (requires an OpenSubsonic-compatible server)
Automatically fetch lyrics in the background for tracks that don\'t have them cached yet. Off by default — you can still sync manually below.
Fetches lyrics in the background for offline playback, preferring your library\'s already-cached tracks first.
This re-checks lyrics for every track in your library, not just the ones never checked before.
This deletes every cached word-synced lyrics entry on this device. Nothing is removed from the server.
Removes stale/duplicate download files and re-checks that fully-downloaded playlists still have every track.
Takes effect the next time the app starts.
Fetches the next few songs in your queue ahead of time so playback starts instantly.
Frees up space immediately, but works best when nothing is currently playing. Downloaded tracks are not affected.
Removes every downloaded track from this device. Nothing is deleted from the server.
Artwork will be re-downloaded as needed. Artwork for downloaded tracks, albums, and playlists is kept separately and isn\'t affected.
Clears the temporary stream cache and artwork cache. Permanent downloads are not affected — use \"Clear\" under Permanent Downloads for those.
This can\'t be undone — it\'ll be re-fetched from Radiant Lyrics next time this track plays.
This deletes every cached word-synced lyrics entry on this device. Nothing is removed from the server.
Report plays back to the server
Audio normalization based on metadata values
Overlaps the end of one song with the start of the next over the duration below.
Keep queueing similar or random tracks when the queue ends
Use the server\'s AudioMuse-AI plugin (Navidrome ≥ 0.62) for similarity, when it\'s available — falls back to plain metadata similarity otherwise.
Save and restore your play queue across devices via the server
Stream everything, skip local downloads entirely
Use the original lossless file on WiFi even if the cached/downloaded copy was transcoded to a lossy format
Prevent the screen from sleeping while playing
Hide explicit content markers and artwork
Replace the player\'s static blurred backdrop with a live, animated warp effect driven by the current cover
Coast the animation to a stop over ~1.8s while paused, instead of freezing mid-motion or continuing at full speed
Dark regions of the cover are pushed toward this color before blurring.
Applies the band gains below to all local playback.
Keeps a rolling in-app log for troubleshooting
Deletes every stored log file, including the current session\'s.
Changes are written directly to the database and cannot be undone
Danger Zone: this is a raw view of the app\'s database. Editing rows directly can corrupt your library and is not reversible.
Saves your library database and app settings to a file you can share or store elsewhere.
Restoring replaces your current library database and settings. Server passwords aren\'t included — you may need to log in again afterward.

This removes its cached library data and saved credentials from this device.
Drag to reorder. This order is used everywhere multiple servers are combined or listed.

Changing this migrates your local library data to the new address.
This migrates your library, downloads, and cached data from \"%1$s\" to \"%2$s\". This can\'t be undone.
Used to import Spotify playlists. Create an app at developer.spotify.com to get these values.
Theme the app from your device\'s system color (Settings → Wallpaper & style, Android 12+)
Dynamic color theming requires Android 12 or newer.
Play animated cover art (native animated WebP, plus looping video where available) in the player and album/playlist headers
Also animate WebP artwork in album grids, not just detail screens

When a track has no animated cover of its own, look one up from a third-party API and play it as a looping muted video. This calls an unofficial, unowned external service (ama.trainswift.net by default) with no uptime guarantee.
Fetches a short audio sample from the server for tracks not already downloaded
Removes all BPM/key/mood analysis results and the skip queue from this device. Nothing is deleted from the server.
When enabled, VeloSonic won\'t attempt any network requests — browse and play only what\'s already downloaded or cached.
This removes every configured server, including local databases, caches, and downloads, from this device.
